evidence: REVISE: valid 20- and 21-byte nonnumeric definition names ending in x after an overflowing decimal prefix were rejected with status 2 and 'error: invalid definition'.
REQUIREMENTS.md permits any 1-31 byte name except a token having the complete integer shape; the failing names do not have that shape.

Two reference builds and a third build from a copied source at a different output path were byte-identical with SHA-256 5b73caee22ee3e317b10049367130fcfb23a4973bff821c38f928cf2b9218e98.

Public tests passed 10/10, sealed tests passed 13/13, and tooling regressions passed 6/6 with no skips; the independent audit reported all 37 required regular files and exact manifest/provenance objects.
The manifest honestly remains GENERATED/PARTIAL, productionized=false, and independent_validation=REQUIRED; benchmark output is explicitly UNVALIDATED_MEASUREMENT and no stronger label is claimed.

Evaluator implementations and answers are confined to sealed/, while the nonsealed surface provides a buildable stub, staged guidance, concepts, design questions, requirements, and black-box examples.
limitations: The immutable source snapshot and linked Jonesforth material were unavailable, so catalog license evidence, source hashes, similarity, and the clean-room claim could not be independently authenticated.
Learner-view exclusion of sealed/ is an external control-plane property and was not transfer-verified in this reviewer workspace.

QEMU 9.1.1 worked with the configured GLib library path, but two non-strace 3-second smoke attempts timed out while later attempts passed; QEMU execution at that bound is inconclusive and is not transfer verification.
No fuzzing, coverage measurement, validated benchmarking, production review, or non-x86 platform validation was performed.

The configured JDK and Arm bare-metal toolchain were available but inapplicable to this x86-64 assembly artifact; host /usr/bin/as and /usr/bin/ld.bfd were required because no configured x86-64 binutils root was supplied.
